title: AI-Powered Network O&M, Ensuring Uninterrupted Network During Power Rationing
summary: The ITU entry reports that operations aided by a telecom foundation model, a transformer with 38 billion parameters, lowered packet loss and delay at MTN without isolating the model's share.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The ITU entry, current to June 2025, describes a telecom foundation model, a transformer with 38 billion parameters. The model supports diagnosis, queries in natural language and optimization recommendations. It works within a system that also uses conventional network maps and routing methods. The entry lists a Huawei employee as a contact and Huawei as the only partner. It reports that with the AI-based system "the packet loss rate and network delay are significantly reduced" at MTN. It does not separate the contribution of the model and gives no effect size. The deployment setting is unclear because the entry describes both an MTN deployment and an internal testbed. On 13 November 2025 TechAfrica News relayed a joint announcement in which Huawei and MTN said that TM Forum had certified MTN South Africa's IP network at autonomous network Level 4. The assessment covered the handling of congestion and path interruption and awarded the highest grade in every dimension of the standard. The network runs Huawei's network digital map and network agent. The announcement gives no figures for packet loss or delay.
purpose: Use model-assisted diagnosis and recommendations to improve network operation during power rationing.
system: AI-Powered Network O&M, Ensuring Uninterrupted Network During Power Rationing
model_version: Telecom foundation model, transformer, 38 billion parameters

ratings.reason: The makers attribute lower packet loss and delay to the combined operational system. AI supports diagnosis and recommendations, and its share of the improvement is not measured separately.
The makers claim a better experience for users, and no source reports an outcome for individual users.
The makers intend improved service to widen access to connectivity, and the operational claim does not show that it has.

ai_role.statement: A 38-billion-parameter transformer supports diagnosis, natural-language-to-SQL analysis, and operational recommendations alongside conventional routing.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 14: AI-Powered Network O&M, Ensuring Uninterrupted Network During Power Rationing
evidence.quote: With the AI-based system, the packet loss rate and network delay are significantly reduced, and network utilization is greatly improved.

evidence.citation: Jennifer Onyeagoro, Huawei and MTN South Africa Drive Global Innovation with First AN L4 IP Network Certification, TechAfrica News, 13 November 2025. The article repeats a joint Huawei and MTN announcement, with quotes from both companies, that TM Forum certified the capabilities of MTN South Africa's IP network for congestion and path interruption optimization; it gives no outcome figures.
evidence.title: Huawei and MTN South Africa Drive Global Innovation with First AN L4 IP Network Certification
evidence.quote: The AN L4 assessment evaluated MTN South Africa's capabilities in network congestion and path interruption optimization, awarding the company the highest grade, "Grade A," across all dimensions of the GB1059C v1.1.0 standard.

evidence.citation: Huawei, Huawei Unveils the AI WAN Solution, Accelerating Transition to the Net5.5G Intelligent Network Era, Huawei news release, 3 March 2025. Huawei launched its AI WAN Solution at MWC Barcelona 2025. It says that MTN South Africa used the system's traffic forecasts to add capacity, and that data use in KwaZulu-Natal rose afterward.
evidence.title: Huawei Unveils the AI WAN Solution, Accelerating Transition to the Net5.5G Intelligent Network Era
evidence.quote: By leveraging AI WAN's millisecond-level traffic collection and minute-level prediction capabilities, MTN has secured an efficient capacity expansion solution. Following deployment, the dataflow of usage (DOU) in KwaZulu-Natal rose by 25%, while traffic grew by 15.4%.
